當麥克風停止傳送音訊，或面板一直處於隱藏狀態時，語音聽寫現在會自動停止並顯示原因。

⟦像開著免持聽筒做筆記，現在比較不會一安靜就被掛斷，真的收不到聲音時也會響一聲告訴你。⟧
body.en:
When dictating notes as you think and pausing for a few seconds, you no longer have to keep reopening the microphone.

The auto-stop idle limit has been extended from 15 seconds without recognized speech or 2 minutes max to 60 seconds or 10 minutes max, so the microphone can stay on longer.

When the microphone stops sending audio or the panel stays hidden, voice dictation now stops automatically and shows why.

⟦Keeping a speakerphone open to take notes, you are less likely to get hung up on the moment things go quiet, and when no sound comes through at all, it chimes to let you know.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Changed voice dictation to stop by itself after 60 seconds without recognized speech or 10 minutes, up from 15 seconds and 2 minutes, so the microphone can stay on longer
[VSCode] Changed voice dictation to stop, and say why, when the microphone stops sending audio or the panel stays hidden

first_title.zh-TW: 終端機 Code Mode 支援四大雲端平台
first_title.en: Code Mode in Terminal Supports Four Cloud Platforms

entries: Follow thread links from search results and transcripts to open saved conversations and nested agents in the terminal. (#62332)
Press `Tab` to complete arguments for supported slash commands. For example, `/mcp lo` completes to `/mcp login`. (#62343)
Jump between task groups in the agent command center with `Shift+Up` and `Shift+Down`. (#62200)
Optional stdio MCP servers with cached tool lists now start on their first tool call by default. (#62366)
Set an approval reviewer for individual connected app tools in `config.toml`. (#62360)

`codex exec resume` restores saved sandbox permissions, the working directory, and workspace roots unless explicitly overridden. (#62194)

The bundled `openai-docs` skill now covers migration to GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, including endpoint choices and tool-calling requirements. (#62447)
Code Mode now uses gRPC for all host connections. The `code_mode_host_grpc` setting is deprecated. (#62476)
Python formatting and SDK type generation now verify dependency hashes against the repository lockfile. (#62346)

title.zh-TW: 搜尋與紀錄裡的對話連結可直接開啟
title.en: Open conversation links directly from search and transcripts

body.zh-TW:
在終端機翻找舊紀錄，常會看到指向其他對話的討論串連結。現在從搜尋結果或對話紀錄跟著這些連結點進去，就能直接在終端機開啟已儲存的對話，也能打開裡面的巢狀代理（由主任務在底層另外分派出去執行的輔助程式）。

⟦紙本通訊錄找到人名後，以前還得另開頁面照著號碼重撥一次，現在手指點一下聯絡人就能直接接通對話。⟧
body.en:
When digging through old transcripts in the terminal, you often see thread links pointing to other conversations. Now you can follow those links from search results or transcripts to open saved conversations directly in the terminal, along with the nested agents (helper programs dispatched underneath by the main task) inside them.

⟦After finding a name in a paper address book, you used to have to open another page and redial the number; now tapping the contact connects the conversation right away.⟧

items.original: Follow thread links from search results and transcripts to open saved conversations and nested agents in the terminal. (#62332)

title.zh-TW: 終端機新增補齊參數與切換快捷鍵
title.en: New terminal shortcuts for argument completion and switching

body.zh-TW:
平時在終端機打指令、切換任務或挑選項，現在都能靠鍵盤直接推進。

輸入支援的斜線指令時，按下 `Tab` 鍵就能自動補齊後面的參數。例如打 `/mcp lo` 後按 `Tab`，會直接補成 `/mcp login`。

進入代理指揮中心查看任務，用 `Shift+Up` 和 `Shift+Down` 就能在不同的任務群組之間跳轉。

遇到選項高度超過終端機作答區的長清單，可用 `PageUp` 和 `PageDown` 捲動閱讀內容並送出回答選項。
body.en:
Typing commands, switching tasks, or picking options in the terminal can now all be driven directly from the keyboard.

When typing a supported slash command, press `Tab` to autocomplete its arguments. For example, typing `/mcp lo` and pressing `Tab` completes it to `/mcp login`.

When viewing tasks in the agent command center, use `Shift+Up` and `Shift+Down` to jump between different task groups.

For long lists whose choices are taller than the terminal's answer area, use `PageUp` and `PageDown` to scroll through the options and submit your answer.

items.original:
Press `Tab` to complete arguments for supported slash commands. For example, `/mcp lo` completes to `/mcp login`. (#62343)
Jump between task groups in the agent command center with `Shift+Up` and `Shift+Down`. (#62200)
Use `PageUp` and `PageDown` to read and submit answer choices that are taller than the terminal’s answer area. (#62209)

title.zh-TW: 有快取的選用 MCP 改為呼叫時啟動
title.en: Cached optional MCP servers now start on first call

body.zh-TW:
工作流程中常會掛載多個 stdio 類型的選用 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器。

只要這些伺服器已經有工具清單的快取（把查過的資料暫存起來直接用），現在預設會等到第一次實際呼叫工具時才啟動。

⟦家裡的家電已經在牆上貼好說明書，以前一進門就把每台機器通電預熱，現在等到真的要按下按鈕時才啟動。⟧
body.en:
Workflows often attach multiple optional stdio MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers.

As long as those servers already have a cached tool list, they now wait until the first actual tool call to start by default.

⟦Home appliances already have manuals taped to the wall: instead of powering on and preheating every machine the moment you walk in, you wait until you actually need to press a button.⟧

items.original: Optional stdio MCP servers with cached tool lists now start on their first tool call by default. (#62366)

title.zh-TW: 個別應用程式工具可指定審核者
title.en: Set approval reviewers for individual app tools

body.zh-TW:
帳號裡接了多個外部服務，不同項目往往需要交給不同人把關。現在可以在 `config.toml` 裡，為個別已連結的應用程式工具單獨設定核准審核者。

⟦使用社區運動中心的不同器材時，以前全由同一位櫃台人員簽核，現在重訓室與泳池能各自指定專人把關放行。⟧
body.en:
When multiple external services are connected to your account, different items often need different people to review them. You can now set an approval reviewer in `config.toml` for each individual connected app tool.

⟦When using different equipment at a community sports center, a single front-desk attendant used to sign off on everything, whereas now the weight room and the pool can each have their own dedicated reviewer.⟧

items.original: Set an approval reviewer for individual connected app tools in `config.toml`. (#62360)

title.zh-TW: 可選用 Amazon Bedrock Runtime
title.en: Support for selecting Amazon Bedrock Runtime

body.zh-TW: 透過 app-server 運作的用戶端，在初始設定或登入帳號時都能直接選擇 Amazon Bedrock Runtime。
body.en: Clients running through app-server can select Amazon Bedrock Runtime directly during initial setup or sign-in.

items.original: App-server clients can select Amazon Bedrock Runtime during setup or sign-in. (#62222)

title.zh-TW: 接續與跨系統遠端工作階段保留路徑權限
title.en: Resumed and cross-OS remote sessions preserve paths and permissions

body.zh-TW:
重新接手先前的任務，或是跨作業系統連線執行遠端操作，最怕工作路徑與權限設定跑掉。

執行 `codex exec resume` 接續任務時，會自動還原先前儲存的沙盒（限制程式存取範圍的隔離環境）權限、工作目錄與工作區根目錄。只要沒有另外明確指定覆寫，這些設定都會照舊套用。

如果用戶端和伺服器跑在不同的作業系統上，遠端工作階段也會完整保留工作目錄、工作區根目錄與可寫入路徑。

⟦帶著畫箱到不同城市寫生時，以前每換一個地點就得重調顏料與筆刷位置，現在打開蓋子就能接回原本順手的擺法。⟧
body.en:
When picking up a previous task or connecting across operating systems for remote work, the last thing you want is for working paths and permission settings to drift.

When running `codex exec resume` to continue a task, previously saved sandbox (an isolated environment that restricts program access) permissions, the working directory, and workspace roots are automatically restored. Unless explicitly overridden, those settings apply as before.

If the client and server run on different operating systems, remote sessions also preserve working directories, workspace roots, and writable paths.

⟦Picture carrying a paintbox to sketch in different cities: you used to have to rearrange your paints and brushes at every stop, but now opening the lid brings back your familiar layout.⟧

items.original:
`codex exec resume` restores saved sandbox permissions, the working directory, and workspace roots unless explicitly overridden. (#62194)
Remote sessions preserve working directories, workspace roots, and writable paths when the client and server run on different operating systems. (#62375, #62376, #62377)

title.zh-TW: 即時回報錯誤並指出觸及的 API 花費上限
title.en: Report errors immediately and identify API spend limits reached

body.zh-TW:
等待模型逐字回應的過程中，一旦背後發生問題，早點看到明確提示才不用乾等。現在回應串流（模型邊生成邊傳回資料的過程）裡的服務商錯誤一傳回，Codex 就會立刻回報。若觸及 API 花費上限，也會指出達到的是哪一項上限。

⟦刷卡扣款失敗時，以前得等月底對帳單寄來才發現問題，現在交易當下立刻跳出提醒。若是額度滿了，也會寫明是哪一張卡。⟧
body.en:
While waiting for a model's word-by-word reply, seeing a clear error right away saves you from waiting in vain when something goes wrong. Codex now reports provider errors as soon as they arrive in a response stream (data sent back incrementally as the model generates it). If an API spend limit is reached, it also identifies which limit was hit.

⟦Think of a failed card charge: instead of waiting for the monthly statement to spot the problem, an alert pops up the moment the transaction happens, and if a limit is full, it tells you which card hit it.⟧

items.original: Codex reports provider errors as soon as they arrive in a response stream and identifies which API spend limit was reached. (#62329, #62356)

title.zh-TW: 打斷主回合時保留子代理的排隊回覆
title.en: Preserve queued child-agent replies when interrupting a parent turn

body.zh-TW:
主對話進行到一半被你按停時，底下分派出去的子代理可能還有幾則回覆正在排隊。現在中斷這個主對話回合後，子代理已經排進佇列的回覆不會消失，會直接留到下一個回合。

⟦樂團排練時指揮舉手喊停這一段，以前各聲部準備要接唱的樂句會直接作廢，現在會先留在譜架上等下一拍接續。⟧
body.en:
When you stop a main conversation mid-way, child agents dispatched underneath may still have replies waiting in line. Now, interrupting that parent turn keeps those queued child-agent replies instead of dropping them, carrying them over to the next turn.

⟦During an orchestra rehearsal, when the conductor raises a hand to stop a section, the phrases each voice part was ready to sing next used to be discarded, but now they stay on the music stand for the next beat.⟧

items.original: Interrupting a parent turn preserves queued replies from child agents for the next turn. (#62348)

title.zh-TW: 晚完成的雲端回覆會原地更新不亂序
title.en: Late cloud replies update in place to keep order

body.zh-TW:
打開舊對話並載入歷史紀錄後，先前送往雲端的任務可能剛好在這之後才跑完。現在這類晚一點完成的雲端回覆，會直接在原本的位置就地更新，讓終端機裡的對話紀錄維持正確順序。

⟦整理相簿時有幾張照片還在沖洗，以前晚拿到的只能硬貼到最後一頁，現在相簿會先留好原本那格等它補進來。⟧
body.en:
After you open an old conversation and load its history, tasks sent to the cloud earlier may finish right afterward. Those late-arriving cloud replies now update in place at their original position, keeping the terminal transcript in the right order.

⟦Imagine organizing a photo album while a few prints are still being developed: late arrivals used to get stuck onto the last page, whereas now the album reserves their original slots until they come in.⟧

items.original: Cloud replies that finish after history loads now update in place, keeping the terminal transcript in order. (#62403)

title.zh-TW: openai-docs 補齊 GPT-6.2 遷移指引
title.en: openai-docs adds GPT-6.2 migration guidance

body.zh-TW: 準備把現有串接切換到新模型之前，常得先確認呼叫格式與設定細節。Codex 內建的 `openai-docs` 技能現在已收錄遷移至 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 Sol 的說明，涵蓋端點（呼叫模型服務的連線位址）選擇與工具呼叫要求。
body.en: Before switching an existing integration to a new model, you often need to check request formats and configuration details first. Codex's bundled `openai-docs` skill now covers migrating to GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, including endpoint (the connection address for calling a model service) choices and tool-calling requirements.

items.original: The bundled `openai-docs` skill now covers migration to GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, including endpoint choices and tool-calling requirements. (#62447)

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 改統一走 gRPC 並棄用舊設定
title.en: Code Mode Standardizes on gRPC and Deprecates Old Setting

body.zh-TW:
在設定檔裡調整 Code Mode 連線方式的日子告一段落了。現在 Code Mode 的所有主機連線都一律改用 gRPC（一種常見的資料傳輸連線協定），原本的 `code_mode_host_grpc` 設定也隨之標記為棄用。

⟦老舊大樓原本還留著切換舊式電話線的撥鈕，現在所有分機全部改接同一種數位線路，牆上的切換開關也就跟著退役。⟧
body.en:
The days of adjusting how Code Mode connects in the configuration file are over. Code Mode now uses gRPC (a common data-transfer protocol) for all host connections, and the original `code_mode_host_grpc` setting is marked as deprecated.

⟦An old building once kept a toggle for legacy phone lines, and now that every extension has moved to a single digital line, the wall switch has been retired as well.⟧

items.original: Code Mode now uses gRPC for all host connections. The `code_mode_host_grpc` setting is deprecated. (#62476)

title.zh-TW: Python 排版與 SDK 型別會驗證套件雜湊
title.en: Python Formatting and SDK Types Verify Package Hashes

body.zh-TW: 這項變動主要影響參與專案開發的貢獻者。現在執行 Python 程式碼排版與產生 SDK 型別定義時，流程會比對相依套件的雜湊值（用來確認檔案內容是否一致的數位指紋）與程式碼庫的鎖定檔。
body.en: This change mainly affects contributors working on the project. When running Python code formatting and generating SDK type definitions, the workflow now checks dependency hashes (digital fingerprints used to confirm whether file contents match) against the repository lockfile.

items.original: Python formatting and SDK type generation now verify dependency hashes against the repository lockfile. (#62346)

first_title.zh-TW: 模型目錄新增 GPT-6.2 Sol 與 Astra
first_title.en: Model Catalogs Add GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra

entries: Added mouse cursor placement and text selection inside the prompt box in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: click to move the cursor, or drag and double-click (and double-click-drag by word) to highlight text for typing or paste replacement, `Backspace`/`Delete`, `Ctrl+C` copy, and `Ctrl+X` cut without overwriting your clipboard on release. When Vim mode is on, mouse selections outside Insert mode enter characterwise Visual mode so Vim operators and motions act on the selection, and Normal-mode clicks past the end of a line land on the last character.

Improved background shell command tracking by letting `run_command` set a `NotificationTimeoutSeconds` wakeup, so the CLI automatically notifies the agent when a long-running command is still running instead of spending extra turns on separate polling timers.

Improved the `Orchestrator` row in `/model` so that picking the same model and thinking `Effort` for both `Planner` and `Executor` runs single-agent directly on that model — showing it in the status line, inheriting it in `/btw`, and using its context window in `/context` — while distinct `Effort` levels of the same model family continue to run two-phase plan-and-execute.
Improved the `Orchestrator` row in `/model` by bracketing the focused thinking `Effort` choice (such as `[high]`) and labeling `Tab` as `tab Next Field` instead of `tab Effort`.
Improved `/usage` to format quota refresh countdowns of 24 hours or longer in days, hours, and minutes (such as `in 3d 3h 59m` instead of `in 75h 59m`).

Improved MCP server OAuth sign-in in `/mcp` and `/plugin` to request `offline_access` when the server specifies scopes and its authorization server advertises `offline_access`, so remote MCP servers such as Vercel's issue refresh tokens instead of disconnecting when the initial access token expires.

Fixed pressing `Tab` in the `/` slash-command autocomplete menu doing nothing when multiple commands shared what you typed, after navigating with `↑` or `↓`, or right after a `plugin:` prefix; `Tab` now completes the highlighted command and closes the menu whenever no longer common prefix can be extended.

Fixed mouse-wheel scrolling over an open bottom panel or `/`, `@`, or argument dropdown — and `PgUp`, `PgDn`, `Shift+↑`, or `Shift+↓` in panels that page themselves (such as `/help`, `/permissions`, `/skills`, `/context`, and `/usage`) — scrolling the conversation behind the panel instead of the panel itself in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode.
Fixed `agy update` printing status lines with staircase indentation when run in a terminal with raw output mode enabled, while keeping newline-only output when piped or redirected to a file.

Fixed long-running agent turns failing with an `UNAUTHENTICATED` (`401`) error when a Google OAuth access token crossed its one-hour expiry; the CLI now refreshes tokens ahead of expiry and retries a pre-stream `401` automatically.

Fixed long, multi-part streaming model responses discarding their progress and restarting or failing the turn when a continuation request hit a temporary model capacity (`503` / `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED`) error; the CLI now retries and resumes from where the response left off.

Fixed turns on Gemini Enterprise accounts with an empty prepaid wallet retrying repeatedly and reporting `You have exhausted your quota on this model.`; the CLI now stops right away and tells you `Your organization's prepaid balance is insufficient. Contact your administrator to add funds.` (with an `Organization prepaid wallet is empty` notice in the Remote Control browser view).

Fixed Gemini Enterprise and enterprise model-gateway sessions with non-workspace file access allowed bypassing built-in approval and deny protections on sensitive files such as `.git`, `.env`, `config.json`, `hooks.json`, and `mcp_config.json`.
Fixed plugin CLI tools on Windows running without their configured authentication token when the terminal sandbox is off and your workspace is on a different drive letter than your user profile.

Fixed the model picker in the message box of the Remote Control browser view being locked while a turn is running; you can now switch models mid-turn for `/btw` side questions and messages sent after the current turn.
Fixed LaTeX math blocks containing `\label{...}` failing to render with `Failed to render LaTeX` in the Remote Control browser view.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕輸入框支援滑鼠點選與反白
title.en: Mouse Cursor Placement and Selection in Full-Screen Input

body.zh-TW:
寫了一長串提問想改中間幾個字，不用再按著方向鍵慢慢挪動游標。在 `full screen (altscreen)` 顯示模式的輸入框裡，點一下就能把游標移到指定位置。你也能拖曳、連點兩下，或連點兩下再拖曳來按單字反白文字，放開滑鼠時不會蓋掉原本的剪貼簿內容。選好文字後可直接打字或貼上取代，也支援 `Backspace`、`Delete`、`Ctrl+C` 複製與 `Ctrl+X` 剪下。

如果開啟了 Vim 模式，在 Insert 模式以外用滑鼠選取文字，會進入逐字元選取的 Visual 模式，讓 Vim 的操作與移動指令直接作用在選取範圍上。而在 Normal 模式下點到行尾之後的位置時，游標會落在該行最後一個字元。⟦過去改這幾行字得像用老式打字機一樣一格格挪，現在則能直接拿滑鼠在畫面上點選、拉出反白，整段搬動或替換都不卡手。⟧
body.en:
When you have typed a long prompt and want to change a few words in the middle, you no longer have to hold down arrow keys to nudge the cursor over. Inside the prompt box in `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode, a single click moves the cursor right where you want it. You can also drag, double-click, or double-click and drag by word to highlight text without overwriting your clipboard on release. Once selected, you can type or paste to replace it, or use `Backspace`, `Delete`, `Ctrl+C` to copy, and `Ctrl+X` to cut.

When Vim mode is on, selecting text with the mouse outside Insert mode enters characterwise Visual mode so Vim operators and motions act directly on the selection. Clicking past the end of a line in Normal mode places the cursor on the last character of that line. ⟦Editing those few lines used to feel like nudging an old typewriter carriage one space at a time, whereas now you can click and drag right on the screen to highlight and move or swap whole chunks effortlessly.⟧

items.original: Added mouse cursor placement and text selection inside the prompt box in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: click to move the cursor, or drag and double-click (and double-click-drag by word) to highlight text for typing or paste replacement, `Backspace`/`Delete`, `Ctrl+C` copy, and `Ctrl+X` cut without overwriting your clipboard on release. When Vim mode is on, mouse selections outside Insert mode enter characterwise Visual mode so Vim operators and motions act on the selection, and Normal-mode clicks past the end of a line land on the last character.

title.zh-TW: 背景指令改為主動回報免重複輪詢
title.en: Active Wakeups Replace Polling for Background Commands

body.zh-TW: 交辦長時間執行的背景終端機指令後，過去代理程式得另外開輪詢計時器來回檢查進度。現在追蹤背景指令時能直接排定喚醒通知，指令還在跑的話，CLI 就會自動通知代理程式，省下額外的查詢輪次。⟦不再像等快遞時一直開門探頭，快遞員會在還在路上時主動傳訊息通知，省下一次次白跑。⟧
body.en: After handing off a long-running background shell command, the agent used to spin up separate polling timers to check on progress back and forth. Now, tracking a background command can schedule a wakeup notification directly, so the CLI automatically notifies the agent if the command is still running and saves extra check-in turns. ⟦Instead of opening the door every few minutes to check for a delivery, the courier texts you while still on the way, saving you all those wasted trips.⟧

items.original: Improved background shell command tracking by letting `run_command` set a `NotificationTimeoutSeconds` wakeup, so the CLI automatically notifies the agent when a long-running command is still running instead of spending extra turns on separate polling timers.

title.zh-TW: Orchestrator 支援同設定直跑與新標示
title.en: Direct Single-Agent Runs and New Labels in Orchestrator

body.zh-TW:
在 `/model` 的 `Orchestrator` 這一列挑模型，現在操作更清楚，也不用多繞一圈。目前選中的思考強度 `Effort` 選項會加上方括號，例如 `[high]`，`Tab` 鍵提示也從 `tab Effort` 改成 `tab Next Field`。

只要 `Planner` 和 `Executor` 選用相同模型與 `Effort`，就會直接以單一代理程式在該模型執行。這時終端機底部的狀態列會顯示該模型，`/btw` 會沿用它，`/context` 也會改用它的 context window（模型單次能處理的內容容量上限）。若是同模型家族但選了不同的 `Effort`，則繼續跑先規劃再執行的兩階段模式。⟦跟寫作時一樣，若構思大綱和潤稿都用同一套標準，不如直接一氣呵成；只有兩階段想用不同力道時，才值得分兩輪處理。⟧
body.en:
Picking a model on the `Orchestrator` row in `/model` is now clearer and avoids unnecessary detours. The currently selected thinking `Effort` option is wrapped in brackets, such as `[high]`, and the `Tab` hint changes from `tab Effort` to `tab Next Field`.

Whenever `Planner` and `Executor` use the same model and `Effort`, it runs directly as a single agent on that model. At that point, the status line at the bottom of the terminal shows that model, `/btw` inherits it, and `/context` switches to its context window (the maximum amount of content a model can process at once). If you choose different `Effort` levels within the same model family, it continues running the two-phase plan-and-execute mode. ⟦Think of writing a piece: if you apply the same standard to both outlining and polishing, it makes more sense to write it straight through, and only split into two passes when each stage calls for a different level of effort.⟧

items.original:
Improved the `Orchestrator` row in `/model` so that picking the same model and thinking `Effort` for both `Planner` and `Executor` runs single-agent directly on that model — showing it in the status line, inheriting it in `/btw`, and using its context window in `/context` — while distinct `Effort` levels of the same model family continue to run two-phase plan-and-execute.
Improved the `Orchestrator` row in `/model` by bracketing the focused thinking `Effort` choice (such as `[high]`) and labeling `Tab` as `tab Next Field` instead of `tab Effort`.

title.zh-TW: /usage 滿一天改用天數顯示額度倒數
title.en: /usage Shows Quota Countdowns in Days Over 24 Hours

body.zh-TW: 想確認還要等多久才會重算額度，過去遇到大於一整天的數字，得自己把小時換算成天數。現在輸入 `/usage` 查看，只要額度更新倒數滿 24 小時以上，就會改用天、小時與分鐘顯示。舉例來說，畫面上會寫成 `in 3d 3h 59m`，不再是原本的 `in 75h 59m`。
body.en: When checking how long until your quota resets, any number over a full day used to require converting hours into days in your head. Now, running `/usage` displays quota refresh countdowns of 24 hours or longer in days, hours, and minutes. For example, the screen shows `in 3d 3h 59m` instead of `in 75h 59m`.

items.original: Improved `/usage` to format quota refresh countdowns of 24 hours or longer in days, hours, and minutes (such as `in 3d 3h 59m` instead of `in 75h 59m`).

title.zh-TW: /mcp 與 /plugin 的遠端登入不再過期斷線
title.en: Remote Logins in /mcp and /plugin No Longer Expire Mid-Session

body.zh-TW:
連上遠端工具卻用一陣子就突然斷線，往往是初次登入的憑證過期了。現在透過 `/mcp` 與 `/plugin` 替 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器做 OAuth 登入，會多做一層確認。

只要伺服器有指定權限範圍 `scopes`，且驗證伺服器宣告支援 `offline_access`，CLI 就會一併請求 `offline_access`。這樣像 Vercel 這類遠端伺服器就會核發更新用的 token（驗證用的授權令牌），不至於在原本的存取憑證過期後直接斷線。⟦就像拿著只管一陣子的訪客證進門，時間一到就得重新核對證件；預先申請可換發的憑證後，快過期就能自動換新證，不必中途被請出場。⟧
body.en:
Connecting to a remote tool only to get disconnected after a while often happens because the initial login credential expires. Now, signing in with OAuth for an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a standard for connecting AI to external tools) server via `/mcp` and `/plugin` adds an extra check.

Whenever the server specifies `scopes` and its authorization server advertises `offline_access`, the CLI requests `offline_access` as well. That way, remote servers like Vercel issue refresh tokens (credentials used for authentication) so you do not get disconnected as soon as the initial access credential expires. ⟦Picture entering a building with a temporary visitor pass that forces another ID check once it expires; requesting a renewable pass upfront lets it swap for a fresh one before time runs out, so you are not escorted out mid-visit.⟧

items.original: Improved MCP server OAuth sign-in in `/mcp` and `/plugin` to request `offline_access` when the server specifies scopes and its authorization server advertises `offline_access`, so remote MCP servers such as Vercel's issue refresh tokens instead of disconnecting when the initial access token expires.

title.zh-TW: 修正斜線指令選單按 Tab 補全失效
title.en: Fixed Tab Completion in the Slash-Command Menu

body.zh-TW: 打 `/` 叫出指令補全選單後，過去只要多個指令開頭相同、用 `↑` 或 `↓` 切換過項目，或剛輸入 `plugin:`，按 `Tab` 都會完全沒反應。這個問題已經修好，現在只要沒有更長的共同前綴可以延伸，按 `Tab` 就會補全目前反白的指令並關閉選單。
body.en: After typing `/` to open the command completion menu, pressing `Tab` used to do nothing whenever multiple commands shared a prefix, after navigating items with `↑` or `↓`, or right after typing `plugin:`. That is fixed now: whenever no longer common prefix can be extended, pressing `Tab` completes the highlighted command and closes the menu.

items.original: Fixed pressing `Tab` in the `/` slash-command autocomplete menu doing nothing when multiple commands shared what you typed, after navigating with `↑` or `↓`, or right after a `plugin:` prefix; `Tab` now completes the highlighted command and closes the menu whenever no longer common prefix can be extended.

title.zh-TW: 修正全螢幕模式面板與選單捲動錯位
title.en: Fixed Panel and Menu Scrolling in Full-Screen Mode

body.zh-TW:
在 `full screen (altscreen)` 顯示模式下，過去想捲動開啟的面板或選單時，捲動的卻是背後的對話內容。這個問題已經修好，現在把滑鼠滾輪移到底部面板，或 `/`、`@` 與參數下拉選單上捲動，只會捲動面板本身。

在 `/help`、`/permissions`、`/skills`、`/context`、`/usage` 這類會自行分頁的面板操作時也一樣。按 `PgUp`、`PgDn`、`Shift+↑` 或 `Shift+↓`，只會切換面板頁數，不會捲到背後對話。
body.en:
In `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode, trying to scroll an open panel or menu used to scroll the conversation behind it instead. That is fixed now: scrolling the mouse wheel over an open bottom panel or a `/`, `@`, or argument dropdown only scrolls the panel itself.

The same goes for panels that page themselves, such as `/help`, `/permissions`, `/skills`, `/context`, and `/usage`. Pressing `PgUp`, `PgDn`, `Shift+↑`, or `Shift+↓` only flips pages within the panel without scrolling the conversation behind it.

items.original: Fixed mouse-wheel scrolling over an open bottom panel or `/`, `@`, or argument dropdown — and `PgUp`, `PgDn`, `Shift+↑`, or `Shift+↓` in panels that page themselves (such as `/help`, `/permissions`, `/skills`, `/context`, and `/usage`) — scrolling the conversation behind the panel instead of the panel itself in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode.

title.zh-TW: 修正 agy update 狀態訊息階梯縮排
title.en: Fixed Staircase Indentation in agy update Status Output

body.zh-TW: 在終端機開啟 raw output 模式跑更新指令，印出來的每行訊息都會一路往右偏。這個問題已經修好，現在執行 `agy update` 時，每行狀態訊息都會對齊輸出，而透過管線傳輸或導向存進檔案時，仍維持原本的純換行格式。
body.en: When running the update command in a terminal with raw output mode enabled, each printed status line used to drift further to the right. That is fixed now: running `agy update` aligns every status line cleanly, while piped or file-redirected output keeps the original newline-only format.

items.original: Fixed `agy update` printing status lines with staircase indentation when run in a terminal with raw output mode enabled, while keeping newline-only output when piped or redirected to a file.

title.zh-TW: 長對話遇憑證過期或模型滿載可續跑
title.en: Long Sessions Resume Through Token Expiry and Capacity Limits

body.zh-TW:
讓代理程式連續跑比較久的任務，最怕快完成時遇到中途連線狀況而整段白費。

當 Google OAuth 的存取 token 跨過一小時效期，過去會直接跳出 `UNAUTHENTICATED` 與 `401` 錯誤而中斷。現在 CLI 會在過期前預先更新 token，串流開始前若遇到 `401` 也會自動重試。

若是分多段串流的長篇模型回應，續傳遇到暫時性 `503` 或 `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` 容量不足錯誤，過去會丟失進度而重來或失敗。現在 CLI 會自動重試，直接從原本中斷的地方接續完成。
body.en:
When letting an agent run a longer task continuously, the worst feeling is hitting a mid-run connection issue right before the finish line and losing the whole stretch.

When a Google OAuth access token crosses its one-hour expiry, it used to fail right away with `UNAUTHENTICATED` and `401` errors. Now the CLI refreshes the token before it expires, and automatically retries if it hits a `401` before streaming starts.

For long, multi-part streaming model responses, hitting a temporary `503` or `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` capacity error during continuation used to discard progress and restart or fail. Now the CLI retries automatically and picks up right where it left off.

items.original:
Fixed long-running agent turns failing with an `UNAUTHENTICATED` (`401`) error when a Google OAuth access token crossed its one-hour expiry; the CLI now refreshes tokens ahead of expiry and retries a pre-stream `401` automatically.
Fixed long, multi-part streaming model responses discarding their progress and restarting or failing the turn when a continuation request hit a temporary model capacity (`503` / `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED`) error; the CLI now retries and resumes from where the response left off.

title.zh-TW: 修正企業預付餘額歸零時的錯誤提示
title.en: Fixed Error Message When Enterprise Prepaid Balance Hits Zero

body.zh-TW:
Gemini Enterprise 預付錢包歸零後，過去會反覆重試並誤報額度用完的 `You have exhausted your quota on this model.`。現在 CLI 會立刻停止，改顯示下列提示：

```
Your organization's prepaid balance is insufficient. Contact your administrator to add funds.
```

遠端控制網頁上也會顯示 `Organization prepaid wallet is empty` 的提醒。
body.en:
When a Gemini Enterprise prepaid wallet hit zero, the CLI used to retry repeatedly and mistakenly report `You have exhausted your quota on this model.`. Now the CLI stops immediately and displays the following message instead:

```
Your organization's prepaid balance is insufficient. Contact your administrator to add funds.
```

The Remote Control web view also shows an `Organization prepaid wallet is empty` notice.

items.original: Fixed turns on Gemini Enterprise accounts with an empty prepaid wallet retrying repeatedly and reporting `You have exhausted your quota on this model.`; the CLI now stops right away and tells you `Your organization's prepaid balance is insufficient. Contact your administrator to add funds.` (with an `Organization prepaid wallet is empty` notice in the Remote Control browser view).

title.zh-TW: 修正企業版存取外部檔案繞過敏感檔保護
title.en: Fix sensitive file protections bypassed by enterprise external access

body.zh-TW: 你使用 Gemini Enterprise 或企業模型閘道的工作階段，且允許取用工作區以外的路徑，過去卻會直接跳過確認與封鎖關卡。受影響的敏感檔案包括 `.git`、`.env`、`config.json`、`hooks.json` 與 `mcp_config.json`。這個問題已經修好，現在內建的核准與拒絕保護機制不會再被繞過。
body.en: When you used Gemini Enterprise or enterprise model-gateway sessions with access to paths outside the workspace allowed, confirmation and block checks used to be skipped. Affected sensitive files include `.git`, `.env`, `config.json`, `hooks.json`, and `mcp_config.json`. This issue is fixed, and built-in approval and deny protections are no longer bypassed.

items.original: Fixed Gemini Enterprise and enterprise model-gateway sessions with non-workspace file access allowed bypassing built-in approval and deny protections on sensitive files such as `.git`, `.env`, `config.json`, `hooks.json`, and `mcp_config.json`.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 跨磁碟執行外掛漏帶 token
title.en: Fix missing token when running plugins across Windows drives

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上關掉終端機沙盒，又把工作區和使用者設定檔分開放在不同槽，過去啟動 CLI 工具時會少帶驗證資訊。這個問題已經修好，現在外掛工具能順利取得原本設定的驗證 token 執行。
body.en: When the terminal sandbox was off on Windows and your workspace and user profile were on different drives, launching CLI tools used to miss authentication details. This issue is fixed, so plugin tools now run with their configured authentication token.

items.original: Fixed plugin CLI tools on Windows running without their configured authentication token when the terminal sandbox is off and your workspace is on a different drive letter than your user profile.

title.zh-TW: 修正遠端控制網頁回應期間鎖定模型選單
title.en: Fix model picker locked during responses in Remote Control

body.zh-TW: 這一輪還在跑的時候，你想在瀏覽器裡先換個選項來發問，卻發現訊息框裡的切換鈕完全按不動。這個問題已經修好，現在遠端控制網頁在回應進行到一半時也能切換模型，用來處理 `/btw` 順帶提問或接在這一輪之後送出的訊息。
body.en: While a turn was still running, trying to switch options in the browser to ask a question meant the toggle in the message box would not respond at all. This issue is fixed, so the Remote Control browser view now lets you switch models mid-turn for `/btw` side questions or messages sent after the current turn.

items.original: Fixed the model picker in the message box of the Remote Control browser view being locked while a turn is running; you can now switch models mid-turn for `/btw` side questions and messages sent after the current turn.

title.zh-TW: 修正遠端控制網頁含 \label 數學式無法顯示
title.en: Fix LaTeX math with \label failing to render in Remote Control

body.zh-TW: 在瀏覽器打開 AI 算出的 LaTeX 公式，過去只要裡面帶有標籤，畫面上就會跳出 `Failed to render LaTeX` 錯誤。這個問題已經修好，現在遠端控制網頁也能正常顯示含有 `\label{...}` 標籤的數學區塊。
body.en: When opening LaTeX formulas generated by AI in the browser, any formula containing a label used to trigger a `Failed to render LaTeX` error on screen. This issue is fixed, and the Remote Control browser view now properly renders math blocks containing `\label{...}` tags.

items.original: Fixed LaTeX math blocks containing `\label{...}` failing to render with `Failed to render LaTeX` in the Remote Control browser view.

first_title.zh-TW: 指令列支援 -r 與 --resume 接續對話
first_title.en: CLI supports -r and --resume to resume conversations

entries: MCP tool results that contain images now include those images in headless streaming and JSON output
Clickable `file://` links to local files now open the file the same way bare paths do
Question cards in minimal mode now keep the first option visible instead of scrolling it off-screen
Session resume errors now give the same helpful instruction on every route instead of suggesting the TUI picker
`grok inspect` now shows the hooks a headless run would actually load, with a note for those that still need folder trust
Image paste with `grok wrap` now works when Grok runs inside a remote tmux or through a second wrap
`grok` no longer watches every directory when only tracking the current git branch

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式輸出也會帶出 MCP 工具的圖片
title.en: Headless output now includes images from MCP tools

body.zh-TW:
把 Grok 接進自動化腳本裡，靠 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）查來的圖片結果，以前往往沒辦法跟著資料一起送出來。

現在用無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗與操作畫面的執行方式）執行，無論是即時串流，或是常用來交換資料的 JSON 格式輸出，都會把這些圖片一併包進去。

⟦以前看即時文字轉播只有字沒有圖，現在記者現場拍的照片也會跟著訊息即時進來，事後整理的紀錄檔一樣留得住。⟧
body.en:
When plugging Grok into automation scripts, image results fetched through MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) often could not be sent out along with the data.

Now, when running in headless mode (running without a terminal window or visual interface), both live streams and JSON output commonly used for data exchange include those images.

⟦A live text broadcast used to carry only words without pictures, whereas now photos taken on-site by reporters arrive alongside the updates and stay preserved in the compiled archive afterward.⟧

items.original: MCP tool results that contain images now include those images in headless streaming and JSON output

title.zh-TW: file:// 本地檔案連結會像純路徑一樣開啟
title.en: Local file:// links now open like bare paths

body.zh-TW:
在畫面上看到電腦裡的檔案位置，順手點一下就能開檔最省事。過去遇到 `file://` 開頭的可點擊連結，開啟行為跟單純寫出路徑並不一樣。

現在只要點擊指向本地檔案的 `file://` 連結，就會用跟純檔案路徑相同的方式把檔案打開。
body.en:
Seeing a file location on your computer screen and clicking it directly to open the file is the most convenient approach. Previously, clickable links starting with `file://` behaved differently when opened compared to simply writing out a bare path.

Now, clicking a `file://` link that points to a local file opens it the exact same way a bare file path does.

items.original: Clickable `file://` links to local files now open the file the same way bare paths do

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式提問卡片不再把第一個選項捲出畫面
title.en: Question cards in minimal mode no longer scroll the first option off-screen

body.zh-TW:
開著精簡模式工作，遇到需要你做決定的彈窗，以前最上面的選擇常會自己滑出視野外。

現在這類提問卡片會把第一個選項保留在畫面裡，不會再被捲出可視範圍。
body.en:
When working in minimal mode, pop-ups that ask you to make a decision used to let the top choice slip out of view.

Now, these question cards keep the first option visible on screen instead of scrolling it out of the viewable area.

items.original: Question cards in minimal mode now keep the first option visible instead of scrolling it off-screen

title.zh-TW: 恢復工作階段失敗時各路徑改給一致提示
title.en: Session resume errors now show consistent instructions across routes

body.zh-TW:
想接續先前的工作階段卻失敗，不同入口以前給出的錯誤提示各不相同，有的還會叫你改開終端機互動選單。

現在不論從哪一條路徑發生恢復失敗，Grok 都會給出同一套實用的操作說明，不再建議那個選單。

⟦登山時各個岔路的指標以前常各寫各的，有的甚至叫你回山腳找管理員；現在每個路口都換上同一套清楚的路線牌，照著走就行。⟧
body.en:
When trying to resume a previous session fails, different entry points used to show different error prompts, with some telling you to open the interactive terminal picker instead.

Now, no matter which route a resume failure happens on, Grok gives the same helpful instructions and no longer suggests that picker.

⟦Think of trail signs at mountain forks that used to say different things, with some even sending hikers back to the base to find a ranger; now every junction has the same clear signpost to follow.⟧

items.original: Session resume errors now give the same helpful instruction on every route instead of suggesting the TUI picker

title.zh-TW: grok inspect 會列出無頭模式載入的掛鉤
title.en: grok inspect lists hooks loaded in headless mode

body.zh-TW:
打算讓 Grok 在背景自動跑任務，動手前你通常會想先摸清楚哪些掛鉤（特定事件發生時會被觸發的小程式）會跟著啟動。

現在執行 `grok inspect`，就能看見無頭模式實際會載入的掛鉤清單。如果有些掛鉤還需要取得資料夾信任，旁邊也會附上註記說明。

⟦排練舞台劇前先核對道具清單，過去常到開演才發現哪個機關沒通電；現在上台前就能看清會啟動哪些機關，還需要解鎖授權的也會先標出來。⟧
body.en:
Before having Grok run tasks automatically in the background, you usually want to see which hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) will start alongside it.

Running `grok inspect` now displays the list of hooks that headless mode will actually load. If any hooks still need folder trust, a note is included right beside them.

⟦Picture checking a prop list before a stage rehearsal, where you used to find out only at curtain rise that a mechanism had no power; now you see which mechanisms will activate before going on stage, with anything still needing authorization marked in advance.⟧

items.original: `grok inspect` now shows the hooks a headless run would actually load, with a note for those that still need folder trust

title.zh-TW: 遠端 tmux 或雙層 grok wrap 都能貼上圖片
title.en: Image paste works in remote tmux or nested grok wrap

body.zh-TW:
連到遠方主機開著 tmux（在終端機裡分割並保留多個工作畫面的工具）工作，或是多包了一層啟動 Grok，以前想把圖檔直接放進對話框都會失靈。

現在使用 `grok wrap` 貼上圖片的功能，在這兩種環境下都能正常運作。

⟦隔著玻璃窗遞送設計圖，以前只要多經過一層轉接窗口，手裡的圖就會被擋在外面；現在不管隔了幾道窗，圖片照樣能順利遞進去。⟧
body.en:
When connected to a remote host running tmux (a tool for splitting and keeping multiple workspaces in a terminal), or launching Grok inside an extra wrapper layer, pasting an image file directly into the chat box used to fail.

Now, pasting images with `grok wrap` works properly in both environments.

⟦When passing blueprints through a glass window, adding an extra transfer pane used to block the drawing from getting inside; now the image goes right through no matter how many panes are in between.⟧

items.original: Image paste with `grok wrap` now works when Grok runs inside a remote tmux or through a second wrap

title.zh-TW: 只追蹤目前 Git 分支時不再監看所有資料夾
title.en: Tracking only the current Git branch stops watching all folders

body.zh-TW:
手邊的專案目錄一多，你明明只想讓 `grok` 專心顧好正在開發的 Git 分支（版本控制裡用來區分不同進度的開發線），過去它卻會連帶把每個角落都看一遍。

現在僅僅追蹤當前分支時，`grok` 就不再去監看所有資料夾。

⟦社區保全原本只要確認大門鑰匙有沒有換，卻派人盯緊每一棟樓的每一扇窗；現在只顧著真正要看的那道門，不會再白白耗費力氣。⟧
body.en:
When you have many project directories and only want `grok` to focus on the Git branch (a separate line of development in version control) you are working on, it used to watch every corner as well.

Now, when tracking only the current branch, `grok` no longer watches every directory.

⟦Security guards in a neighborhood used to station someone at every window of every building just to check if the front gate key had changed; now they watch only the gate that actually matters without wasting effort.⟧

items.original: `grok` no longer watches every directory when only tracking the current git branch

first_title.zh-TW: 支援檔案覆蓋系統提示並放寬 -p 順序

entries: On a compacted `session/read` or `session/resume`, a `prunedSubagents` entry now carries the subagent's own `subagentId` and, for a nested subagent, its parent's `parentSubagentId` when they are known, so a client can show a pruned nested subagent under its parent

title.zh-TW: Muse Code 能從圖片生出 3D 模型檔
title.en: Muse Code can generate 3D model files from images

body.en: Have a product sketch or photo of an object you want as a 3D file for a slide deck or website, without knowing how to model? As long as your account plan includes 3D generation, you can now hand Muse Code an image and ask for a 3D model, and it will generate a `GLB`, `FBX`, or `USDZ` file for you. ⟦Picture handing a front-facing photo of an object to a mold maker: instead of learning sculpting tools yourself, they build the 3D model straight from the photo and hand it back.⟧

title.zh-TW: 模型短暫斷線時對話會倒數等候不直接結束
title.en: Sessions wait with a countdown during brief model outages

body.zh-TW: 跑工作階段正順手，最怕模型突然短暫連線中斷、整個回合直接卡斷。現在遇到這種短暫斷線時，工作階段不會立刻結束回合，畫面上會出現清楚的倒數計時，撐過這段斷線後繼續往下跑。⟦好比通話途中車子剛好開進隧道，現在不會立刻掛斷電話，而是先告訴你剩幾秒恢復，出了隧道就接著講。⟧
body.en: When a session is running smoothly, nothing disrupts the flow like a brief model connection drop cutting off the whole turn. Now, during a brief outage like that, the session does not end the turn right away; instead, a clear countdown appears on screen so it can ride out the drop and keep going. ⟦Think of driving into a tunnel mid-call: instead of hanging up immediately, the call tells you how many seconds remain until the signal returns and picks right back up once you exit.⟧

items.original: Sessions now ride out a brief model outage inside the turn with a visible countdown instead of ending the turn

title.zh-TW: 中文或程式碼長對話會在爆窗前及時壓縮
title.en: Long code or CJK sessions now compact before overflowing

body.zh-TW: 貼進大段程式碼或中日韓文字聊長對話時，工作階段以前容易在還沒觸發壓縮前，就先撞上模型的上下文視窗上限。原因是在沒有提供代管網頁搜尋的請求裡，工作階段會丟棄供應商回報的實際提示長度。現在這項數值不再被丟棄，密集內容的工作階段就能趕在爆窗前完成壓縮。⟦換成裝箱寄貨時，箱裡早放滿鐵塊，以前店員沒看磅秤就硬塞到撐破，現在會先看準重量提早換大箱。⟧
body.en: When pasting large blocks of code or CJK text into a long session, the session previously tended to hit the model's context window limit before compaction could trigger. That happened because, in requests that offered no hosted web search, the session discarded the actual prompt size reported by the provider. Now that value is kept, so sessions with dense content can compact before overflowing the window. ⟦A shipping clerk packing a box full of iron blocks used to keep stuffing until the box burst without checking the scale, whereas now they check the weight first and switch to a larger box in time.⟧

items.original: Long sessions with dense content, such as code or CJK text, now compact before they overflow the model's context window. The session no longer discards the provider's reported prompt size when the request offered no hosted web search

title.zh-TW: 遠端橋接裝置不再取得主機殼層或全開權限
title.en: Remotely bridged devices no longer get a host shell or full permissions

body.zh-TW: 從另一台裝置透過信箱或遠端附加連進來操作時，安全性邊界現在收得更緊。透過這兩種方式橋接進來的裝置，不再能於主機上取得殼層操作權限，也不會拿到 `allowAll` 權限的工作階段。至於本機端原本的用戶端行為則完全維持不變。⟦彷彿把營業窗口跟後廚隔開，外部跑腿人員只能在窗口交接，走不進放著爐火與廚具的廚房；店內員工則照常進出。⟧
body.en: When you connect from another device through the mailbox or remote attach, the security boundary is now tighter. Devices bridged in through either method can no longer get shell access on the host or receive an `allowAll` session. Local clients, meanwhile, keep their existing behavior unchanged. ⟦Imagine separating a service counter from the back kitchen: outside couriers can only hand items over at the counter and cannot walk into the kitchen with its stoves and utensils, while in-house staff come and go as usual.⟧

items.original: A device bridged in over the mailbox or remote attach no longer gets a shell or an `allowAll` session on the host; local clients are unchanged

title.zh-TW: 從他處搬移 MCP 伺服器保留環境變數參照
title.en: Migrating MCP servers keeps environment variable references intact

body.zh-TW: 打算把原本在 Claude Code 或 Codex 設定好的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器搬來用嗎？以前搬移時遇到 `${VAR}` 這類變數參照，代理不是直接略過該伺服器，就是要求你貼上真實密鑰。現在搬移過程會直接把 `env`、`url` 和標頭裡的 `${VAR}` 參照原封不動留著。⟦跟搬家時只抄下「水電費自動扣款帳號代號」一樣，不用把銀行卡密碼抄在紙上交給別人，新家照樣能按代號扣款。⟧
body.en: Planning to bring over MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers you already configured in Claude Code or Codex? Previously, when a migration ran into variable references like `${VAR}`, the agent either skipped that server or asked you to paste the actual secret. Now the migration leaves `${VAR}` references in `env`, `url`, and header values intact. ⟦Moving into a new home works the same way if you only write down your utility autopay account code instead of handing someone your bank PIN on paper, so billing still goes through by code at the new place.⟧

items.original: When moving MCP servers over from Claude Code or Codex, the agent now keeps `${VAR}` references in `env`, `url`, and header values instead of leaving the server out or asking you to paste the secret

title.en: Planning a design doc with the plan skill asks one question per turn

body.en: Drafting a proposal with AI can leave you unsure which question to answer first when several arrive at once. Now, when writing a design doc with the plan skill, the agent asks only one open question per turn instead of up to three at a time.

items.original: When the agent plans a design doc with the plan skill, it asks one open question per turn instead of up to three at once

title.zh-TW: 技能開關改用名稱儲存並補強路徑與警告
title.en: Skill toggles save by name with cleaner paths and warnings

body.zh-TW:
想固定技能的開關狀態，或自己寫了一份跟內建同名的技能嗎？

切換開關後，內建技能存為 `bundled:<id>`，外掛技能存為 `plugin:<plugin>:<skill>`，並清掉舊設定項目。搬動檔案仍有效；舊版會忽略這類開關。

內建技能路徑改為 `bundled://skills/<name>/SKILL.md`，不再列出內部套件名；舊的 `bundled://muse-core/...` 路徑與設定鍵仍可用。

`muse exec` 啟動時，若你的技能與內建同名，會提醒並附上 `bundled:<name>` 代碼供開啟內建版。

Windows 專案或使用者 `SKILL.md` 過大時，警告會列出實際超出容量，不再固定寫超出 1 位元組。
body.en:
Want to keep a skill's toggle state consistent, or wrote your own skill with the same name as a built-in one?

When you toggle a skill, built-in skills are saved as `bundled:<id>` and plugin skills as `plugin:<plugin>:<skill>`, clearing out older entries. Moving the files still works; older versions ignore switches saved this way.

Built-in skill paths now use `bundled://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` instead of naming an internal package; old `bundled://muse-core/...` paths and settings keys still work.

When `muse exec` starts up and your skill shares a name with a built-in one, it warns you and includes the `bundled:<name>` ID so you can still open the built-in version.

On Windows, when a project or user `SKILL.md` is too large, the warning now reports how much it actually exceeds the limit instead of always saying 1 byte over.

title.zh-TW: 外掛獨立開關、異常停用與拒絕內建規則
title.en: Separate plugin toggles, safe fallback, and built-in rejection rules

body.zh-TW:
想單獨關掉內建功能，卻擔心設定出錯或撤銷不掉嗎？

`python-env` 與 `guidance-match-requested-length` 已拆為內建外掛，可用 `plugins.activation` 各自關閉。停用 `muse-core` 仍關閉兩者，自裝外掛不得用這兩代號。

讀不到設定檔時，外掛在當次執行一律停用，除非專案設定檔點名開啟，避免 hook（事件觸發的小程式）與連線伺服器意外啟動。

已安裝外掛的技能宣告 `replaces`，警告會點名外掛與該欄位，並忽略該欄位。

用 `muse plugins reject` 撤銷 `foreign-script-guard` 等編進執行檔的外掛，若無項可撤銷，會以 `builtin-plugin-not-revocable` 拒絕，並點名停用開關與環境變數；`muse-core` 仍報 0 筆成功。
body.en:
Want to turn off individual built-in features without worrying about broken settings or unrevocable plugins?

`python-env` and `guidance-match-requested-length` are now split into separate built-in plugins that you can disable individually via `plugins.activation`. Turning off `muse-core` still disables both, and self-installed plugins cannot use either ID.

When the settings file cannot be read, plugins stay disabled for that run unless a project settings file enables them by name, preventing hooks (small programs triggered by events) and connected servers from starting unexpectedly.

If an installed plugin's skill declares `replaces`, a warning names both the plugin and that field, and the field is ignored.

When you run `muse plugins reject` on a binary-compiled plugin like `foreign-script-guard` with nothing to revoke, it now refuses with `builtin-plugin-not-revocable` and names the disable switch and environment variable; `muse-core` still reports 0 items succeeded.

When the settings file cannot be read, plugins are switched off for that run unless a project settings file turns them on by name, so plugins you turned off cannot come back on with their hooks and connected servers

title.zh-TW: 恢復工作階段時補齊狀態說明並重啟 MCP
title.en: Session resume clarifies status and restarts MCP servers

body.zh-TW:
開著多個視窗或曾啟動失敗的舊對話，現在用恢復指令更容易接續。

執行 `/resume` 列出紀錄時，若有些工作階段正開在另一個 Muse 行程裡而被略過，現在會直接顯示略過了幾個。就算只剩這類工作階段，也不會再誤報 `No saved sessions found`。

用 `muse resume` 恢復在啟動階段就中斷的工作階段時，如果當時沒有對話遺失，它現在會直接說明這一點，不再只回報沒有存下紀錄。

先前行程若在 MCP 伺服器啟動到一半時結束，現在恢復該工作階段時會重新啟動那些伺服器，不再讓 MCP 保持停用、進而在有必備伺服器時拒絕執行回合。
body.en:
Older conversations left open across multiple windows or interrupted during startup are now easier to pick up with resume commands.

When `/resume` lists saved logs and skips sessions that are currently open in another Muse process, it now reports how many were skipped. Even if only those sessions exist, it no longer falsely reports `No saved sessions found`.

When `muse resume` restores a session that stopped during startup and no conversation was lost, it now states that directly instead of only reporting that no log was saved.

If the previous process ended while MCP servers were still starting up, resuming that session now restarts those servers instead of leaving MCP disabled and refusing turns when a server is required.

items.original:
`/resume` says how many sessions open in another Muse process it left out, and no longer reports "No saved sessions found" when those are the only ones
`muse resume` explains when a session stopped during startup and no conversation was lost, instead of only reporting that no log was saved
Resuming a session whose earlier process ended while its MCP servers were starting now starts them again, instead of leaving MCP disabled and refusing turns when a server is required

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮與重開後保留資料並消除誤報
title.en: Data retention and false-error fixes after compaction and session reopening

body.zh-TW:
把長對話壓縮或是關掉工作階段重新開啟後，狀態顯示與資料保留都已經修好。

壓縮時若遇到附帶影片的長訊息，完整文字現在會比照一般長訊息存下來。標註檔名的那一行也會像處理圖片那樣，寫明影片本身沒有被保存。

恢復已完成壓縮的工作階段時，旁邊不再誤出現 `runtime closed before context compaction completed` 錯誤列。

重新開啟已經壓縮完畢的工作階段時，畫面也不再誤顯示上下文壓縮未完成的訊息。

body.en:

Resuming a session that has already finished compaction no longer shows a false `runtime closed before context compaction completed` error row beside it.

Reopening a session whose compaction has already finished no longer falsely shows a message saying context compaction did not complete.

After compacting a session, quitting, and reopening it, `/workflows` still keeps the original workflow names, phase plan, and agent rows instead of turning into an empty list.

title.zh-TW: 背景指令的輸出讀取與引用預覽不再混雜
title.en: Cleaner output reading and quoted previews for background commands

body.zh-TW:
回頭翻閱背景指令留下的紀錄，指令本文與輸出現在不會混在一起。

即使背景指令一併存下了完整的執行指令，現在依然能正常讀到它另外存下來的輸出內容。

背景指令文字裡原本的引用參考行，現在會完整保留下來不被清掉。

重新接回舊工作階段時，背景指令的預覽內容會把引用的錯誤細節排除在外；較舊的工作階段在協定中也不再把指令文字標成完整的工具輸出。
body.en:
When you look back at records left by background commands, the command text and its output no longer get mixed together.

Even when a background command also saves the full command that was run, its separately saved output can still be read normally.

Quoted reference lines in background command text are now preserved in full instead of being stripped out.

When reconnecting to an older session, background command previews leave out quoted error details; older sessions also no longer mark command text as full tool output in the session protocol.

items.original:
Read saved output of a background command even when its full command is also saved
Preserve quoted reference lines in background command text
Older sessions no longer advertise command text as full tool output in the session protocol
Keep quoted error details out of resumed background command previews

title.zh-TW: 背景指令結束後會補送通知與最終摘要
title.en: Guaranteed completion notices and final summaries for background commands

body.zh-TW:
背景指令已經跑完，你不用再擔心模型漏接結束消息或交出空白結尾。

當背景指令結束後，若把完成通知寫進工作階段時曾失敗一次，下次報告時這則通知依然會送達模型；以前一旦存檔失敗，模型就永遠不會知道指令已經結束。

若背景指令在該回合結束後才完成，而且代理對結果的回覆剛好是空的，它現在會補寫一段簡短的最終摘要，不再毫無回應就結束。⟦像請同事去列印大批文件，就算第一次沒交回條或忘記在群組留言，下次匯報時進度單照樣會補交到桌上，最後也會附上一句結果說明，不會石沉大海。⟧
body.en:
Once a background command finishes, you no longer have to worry about the model missing the completion notice or ending with a blank reply.

When a background command finishes and saving its completion notice to the session fails once, the notice still reaches the model on the next report; previously, if saving failed, the model would never know the command had ended.

If a background command finishes after the turn ends and the agent's reply to the result happens to be empty, it now writes a short final summary instead of ending with no response. ⟦Asking a colleague to print a large batch of documents works the same way: even if they miss handing in the slip the first time or forget to post in the group chat, the progress sheet still lands on your desk at the next check-in, and a brief note on the result is included at the end instead of vanishing without a trace.⟧

items.original:
When a background command finishes after the turn ends and the agent's reply to its result is empty, the agent now writes a short final summary instead of ending with no answer
When a background command finishes and saving its completion notice to the session fails once, the notice now reaches the model on the next report; before, the model was never told the command had ended

title.zh-TW: 子代理訊息排隊、背景喚醒與最新回覆修復
title.en: Fixes for subagent message queuing, background wakeups, and latest replies

body.zh-TW:
交辦給子代理的任務在傳訊、壓縮或重開工作階段後，現在都能正常接上進度。

代理替子代理把訊息排進佇列時，工具結果現在只會說明訊息已排隊，不再顯示容易讓代理誤認成訊息編號的內部追蹤號。

設有目標時，子代理被自身背景工作喚醒並進行壓縮時，不會再存下損壞的檢查點，免得工作階段讀不到子代理或讓 `exec` 報錯結束。

有後續追問的子代理壓縮自身紀錄並重開工作階段後，讀取結果會回傳最新回答，不再誤判為過期；較早版本存下的工作階段仍會顯示過期。
body.en:
Tasks delegated to a subagent can now pick up cleanly after messaging, compaction, or reopening a session.

When an agent queues a message for a subagent, the tool result now only states that the message was queued and no longer shows an internal tracking number that the agent could mistake for a message ID.

When a goal is set, a subagent woken by its own background work and performing compaction no longer saves a broken checkpoint, preventing the session from failing to read the subagent or causing `exec` to exit with an error.

After a subagent with follow-up questions compacts its own history and the session is reopened, reading its result now returns the latest answer instead of falsely marking it as out of date; sessions saved by earlier versions still show as out of date.

items.original:
When the agent queues a message for a subagent, the tool result now says the message was queued for the subagent instead of naming an internal tracking number the agent could mistake for the message's id
When a goal is set, a subagent woken by its own background work no longer saves a broken checkpoint as it compacts, which could stop the session from reading the subagent and end an `exec` run with an error
After a subagent with follow-ups compacts its own history and the session is reopened, reading that subagent's result now returns its latest answer instead of saying the result is out of date; sessions saved by earlier versions still say it is out of date

title.zh-TW: 手動停止的子代理一律改為顯示 stopped
title.en: Manually stopped subagents now consistently show stopped

body.zh-TW: 在系統裡中斷分派出去的任務後，回頭檢查 `/subagents` 清單與詳情頁，以前卻會看到令人疑惑的 `cancelled` 字樣。現在無論是一般或巢狀子代理，只要是由你親手停掉，兩處畫面都會改為顯示 `stopped`，與實際的工作狀態一致。
body.en: After stopping a delegated task in the system, checking the `/subagents` list and detail view used to show a confusing `cancelled` label. Now, whether it is a regular or nested subagent, as long as you stopped it yourself, both views display `stopped` to match its actual work status.

items.original:
In `/subagents` and the subagent detail view, a subagent you stopped now reads `stopped` instead of `cancelled`, matching its work status
In `/subagents`, a nested subagent you stopped now reads `stopped` instead of `cancelled`, matching its work status

title.zh-TW: Shell 指令啟動失敗提醒與結束清理更明確
title.en: Clearer shell startup failure alerts and exit cleanup

body.zh-TW:
在 Linux 上，沙盒若因資料夾位置被空檔案（如 `~/.config`）佔住而失敗，錯誤會點名該檔案，並提示等其他沙盒指令都結束後刪除重跑。

未安裝 `zsh` 等原因導致指令無法啟動時，錯誤訊息會直接指出失敗的程式與資料夾，不再只顯示 `No such file or directory`。

按下 Esc 中斷或逾時後，若無法確認處理程序是否結束，指令仍顯示取消或逾時，另外附上清理未確認的訊息 `cleanup not confirmed: <reason>`，讓你和模型知道衍生程式可能還在跑。

在 Windows 退出 `tbh` 或結束 `tbh exec` 時，未開沙盒的 PowerShell 背景工作階段啟動的程式也會一併結束，不再留在背景。這與 macOS、Linux 原本的處理一致。
body.en:
On Linux, if the sandbox fails because an empty file such as `~/.config` is occupying a needed directory path, the error names that file and tells you to delete it and rerun once all other sandboxed commands have finished.

When a command fails to start because `zsh` is not installed or for similar reasons, the error message now points directly to the failing program and folder instead of only showing `No such file or directory`.

After interrupting with Esc or hitting a timeout, if it cannot be confirmed that the processes have ended, the command still shows as cancelled or timed out and adds `cleanup not confirmed: <reason>`, letting you and the model know spawned programs may still be running.

On Windows, quitting `tbh` or finishing `tbh exec` now also terminates programs started by an unsandboxed PowerShell background session instead of leaving them in the background. This matches how macOS and Linux already behave.

items.original:
On Linux, when a sandboxed shell command cannot start because an empty file such as `~/.config` sits where a directory is needed, the error now names that file and says to remove it and run the command again once no sandboxed command is running
When a shell command cannot start, for example because `zsh` is not installed, the error now names the program and folder that failed instead of only "No such file or directory"
When you stop a shell command (Esc, or it hits its time limit) and its processes cannot be confirmed to have ended, the command still shows as cancelled or timed out, and now also shows `cleanup not confirmed: <reason>`, so you and the model know something it started may still be running
On Windows, quitting tbh or finishing `tbh exec` now also ends the programs a background PowerShell session started (run without the sandbox), as it already did on macOS and Linux, instead of leaving them running

title.zh-TW: 關閉沙盒時的起始權限提示改寫為使用者範圍
title.en: Startup permission note scoped to current user when sandbox is off

body.zh-TW: 關掉 Shell 沙盒時，工作階段一開始顯示的權限說明以前會寫成指令可以修改主機上的任何檔案。現在這段文字改得更準確，只會說明指令能修改目前這位使用者在這台主機任何位置有權寫入的檔案。
body.en: When the shell sandbox is turned off, the permission note shown at the start of a session used to state that commands could modify any file on the host. That text is now more accurate, stating only that commands can modify files that the current user has permission to write anywhere on this host.

items.original: With the shell sandbox off, the session-start permission note now says a command can change any file this user can write, anywhere on this host, instead of claiming it can change any file on the host

title.zh-TW: 修正任務列多餘標籤與工具重試標記
title.en: Fixes for stray task row labels and tool retry marks

body.zh-TW:
在終端機觀察執行進度或下載檔案時，畫面上終於不會再出現讓人誤判的殘留文字或錯誤圖示。

指令只印出一行空白行時，任務列不會再多出孤零零的 `output:` 或 `status:` 字樣。

用 `web_fetch` 存下 PDF 這類二進位檔案時，回傳結果不再提到這個工具並不接受的提示詞。

被修正並重試的呼叫若重試成功，畫面會改為顯示成功標記；要是重試後的指令本身依然失敗，則會保留失敗標記。
body.en:
When watching execution progress or downloading files in the terminal, misleading leftover text and wrong icons no longer appear on screen.

When a command prints only a blank line, task rows no longer show a stray `output:` or `status:` label.

When using `web_fetch` to save a binary file such as a PDF, the returned result no longer mentions a prompt that the tool does not accept.

If a corrected and retried call succeeds on retry, the UI switches to a success mark; if the retried command itself still fails, it keeps the failure mark.

items.original:
Task rows no longer show a stray output: or status: word when a command printed only a blank line
When `web_fetch` saves a binary file such as a PDF, its result no longer mentions a prompt the tool does not take
A corrected call shows the success mark when its retry succeeded, and keeps the failure mark when the retried command itself failed

title.zh-TW: Windows 乾淨 worktree 結束後會正確清除
title.en: Clean worktrees on Windows now remove properly on exit

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 用 `--worktree create` 建立乾淨的 worktree（讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時，工作階段結束後原本應該自動清掉。但以前清理常會因為 `Permission denied` 失敗，導致這個工作區被留在原地。這個問題已經修好，現在這類乾淨的工作區會在工作階段結束時正確移除。
body.en: On Windows, when creating a clean worktree (a feature that lets you open multiple parallel copies of the same project) with `--worktree create`, it is supposed to be cleaned up automatically after the session ends. Previously, cleanup often failed with `Permission denied`, leaving the workspace behind. That issue is now fixed, and clean workspaces like this are properly removed when the session ends.

items.original: On Windows, a clean `--worktree create` session worktree is now removed when the session ends instead of being kept after a "Permission denied" cleanup failure

title.zh-TW: 停寫紀錄時不再新增指定空目錄與離開紀錄
title.en: No extra empty folders or exit records when session logging is off

body.zh-TW:
你加上 `--no-session-log` 跑完後，以前資料夾裡還是會多出幾個用不到的項目。

在 Linux 或 macOS 終端機或執行 `exec` 時加上這個參數，不會再於資料夾裡建出空的 `session-server` 和 `runtime` 資料夾。

用 `tbh serve`（含 `--listen` 模式）搭配 `--no-session-log` 啟動時，不會再把 `serve-exit.jsonl` 寫進資料夾。它仍會在標準錯誤輸出印出離開原因。

⟦就像退租時說好不留任何雜物，以前房客走後桌上還是會擺幾個空紙箱和一張退房單，現在房間裡乾乾淨淨，只剩門口口頭交代一句離開原因。⟧
body.en:
After running with `--no-session-log`, a few unused items used to still show up in your folder.

Adding this flag in the Linux or macOS terminal or when running `exec` no longer creates empty `session-server` and `runtime` folders in that directory.

When starting `tbh serve` with `--no-session-log`, including `--listen` mode, `serve-exit.jsonl` is no longer written to the folder. It still prints the exit reason to standard error.

⟦When a tenant moves out after agreeing to leave nothing behind, there used to still be a few empty cardboard boxes and a checkout slip left on the table; now the room is completely empty, with only a quick spoken note at the door explaining why they left.⟧

items.original:
On Linux or macOS, `--no-session-log` in the terminal or `exec` no longer creates empty `session-server` and `runtime` folders in your data folder
A `tbh serve` host started with `--no-session-log`, including `--listen`, no longer writes its exit record (`serve-exit.jsonl`) into your data folder; it still prints why it exited on stderr

title.zh-TW: muse serve 模型判定與目標排程工具啟動
title.en: muse serve Model Selection and Goal and Cron Tool Startup

body.zh-TW:
透過 `muse serve` 提供的工作階段，在模型判斷與啟動檢查上現在更貼近終端機介面。

挑選審核批示用的模型時，`muse serve` 現在會比照終端機介面從工作階段本身與模型目錄來選，不再一律拿主機的預設模型來審核。

搭配 Meta 模型與模型清單讀取時，`muse serve` 會按啟動時使用的模型視窗來回報上下文用量（清單沒列出的模型也算），不再誤用預設模型視窗或乾脆不回報。

若 `muse serve` 工作階段的工具清單指定了內建的目標或排程工具（如 `report_progress` 或 `cron_list`），現在能正常啟動，不會再報未知工具名稱錯誤。
body.en:
Sessions served through `muse serve` now match the terminal interface more closely for model selection and startup checks.

When picking a model for approval reviews, `muse serve` now selects from the session itself and the model catalog just like the terminal interface, instead of always using the host's default model.

When working with a Meta model and reading a model list, `muse serve` reports context usage against the context window of the model it starts with (including models not on the list), rather than falling back to the default model's window or reporting nothing.

If a `muse serve` session's tool list specifies a built-in goal or cron tool (such as `report_progress` or `cron_list`), it now starts normally instead of failing with an unknown tool names error.

items.original:
Sessions served by `muse serve` now pick the approval reviewer's model as the TUI does, from the session's model and the model catalog, instead of always reviewing on the host's default model
With a Meta model and a model list to read, `muse serve` reports context usage against the window of the model it starts with, including a model the list does not show, instead of the default model's window or none
`muse serve` sessions whose `run.toolset` names a goal or cron tool the session provides, such as `report_progress` or `cron_list`, now start instead of failing with an unknown tool names error

title.zh-TW: 回溯忙碌的工作階段不會再無限期枯等
title.en: Rewinding a Busy Session No Longer Waits Indefinitely

body.zh-TW: 想從某個工作階段倒帶回溯時，如果來源工作階段當時太忙、騰不出手來處理，以前畫面會一直乾等下去。這個問題已經修好，現在只要超過請求逾時時間就會直接回報失敗，不會再無止境卡住。
body.en: Previously, when rewinding from a session that was too busy to handle the request, the interface would wait indefinitely. This is now fixed so it fails once the request timeout is reached instead of hanging forever.

items.original: A rewind no longer waits forever when the session it starts from is too busy to take it; it now fails after the request timeout

title.zh-TW: 正式版不再誤套測試設定而暫停寫入紀錄
title.en: Release Builds No Longer Pause History Writes From Test Settings

body.zh-TW: 在正式發行的軟體版本中，以前若不慎繼承到開發時的實驗參數，程式可能會假裝磁碟空間已滿，或是突然停止記錄工作階段歷史。這項異常已經修復，正式發行版不會再被這些測試設定影響。
body.en: In release builds, inheriting experimental development settings by mistake could previously cause the app to simulate a full disk or stop recording session history. This issue is now fixed so release builds are no longer affected by those test settings.

items.original: Inherited test settings no longer simulate a full disk or pause session history writes in release builds

title.zh-TW: 協定開發者：壓縮後可正確呈現巢狀子代理
title.en: Protocol Developers: Nested Subagents Display Properly After Compaction

body.zh-TW:
給串接工作階段協定的開發者：經過壓縮的工作階段在讀取或恢復後，被裁減的子代理資料現在更能還原階層與狀態。

在壓縮過的工作階段回傳裡，被裁減的子代理會帶上已知的自身識別碼；若是巢狀子代理，已知的父代理識別碼也會附上，讓用戶端能將它排在父代理底下。

當工作階段經過第二次壓縮後，在兩次壓縮之間就已完成的子代理會正確標為已完成，不再誤顯示為執行中。跨越壓縮分界才記錄到啟動的已完成子代理也會被保留，並同樣帶出巢狀子代理的父代關聯。⟦跟把厚厚的會議紀錄一再濃縮一樣，雖然內文變精簡了，外包團隊的完工狀態與上下級隸屬關係仍會清楚附在後面，不會讓人分不清誰歸誰管。⟧
body.en:
For developers integrating the session protocol: after reading or resuming a compacted session, pruned subagent data now better restores hierarchy and status.

In responses for compacted sessions, a pruned subagent now includes its own ID when known, and for a nested subagent, its parent subagent ID is also included when known so clients can display it under its parent.

When a session goes through a second compaction, subagents that finished between the two compactions are now accurately marked as finished rather than shown as running. Finished subagents whose spawn was recorded across the compaction boundary are also preserved, along with parent links for nested subagents. ⟦Much like condensing thick meeting minutes over and over, even though the main text gets shorter, the completion status and reporting hierarchy of outsourced teams stay clearly attached at the end so no one loses track of who reports to whom.⟧

items.original:
On a compacted `session/read` or `session/resume`, a `prunedSubagents` entry now carries the subagent's own `subagentId` and, for a nested subagent, its parent's `parentSubagentId` when they are known, so a client can show a pruned nested subagent under its parent
After a session is compacted a second time, the `prunedSubagents` list on `session/read` and `session/resume` shows a subagent that finished between the two compactions as finished instead of running, keeps a finished subagent whose spawn was recorded across the cut, and lists the parent of a pruned nested subagent so the nested subagent shows under it

title.zh-TW: 協定開發者：分支參數、目標時間與回合數更新
title.en: Protocol Developers: Fork Parameters, Goal Timestamps, and Turn Counts

body.zh-TW:
給串接工作階段協定的開發者：工作階段的分支、目標通知與回合統計欄位都有補充。

建立工作階段分支時，現在比照啟動與恢復工作階段，可以傳入新工作階段的模型與設定（屬實驗性欄位）。若模型遭拒或有設定未套用，回應裡也會分別附上拒絕說明與警告訊息。

代理透過目標工具修改目標後，收到的目標變更通知現在會一併帶上該目標的建立時間與更新時間。

列出、讀取或恢復工作階段時，回傳的回合總數現在會把每一輪都算進去，包含失敗的回合、被打斷且撤回的回合，以及仍在執行中的回合。
body.en:
For developers integrating the session protocol: session forking, goal notifications, and turn count fields have all been expanded.

When forking a session, you can now pass the new session's model and configuration just like when starting or resuming a session (experimental fields). If the model is refused or any settings are not applied, the response also includes a refusal explanation and warning messages.

After an agent modifies a goal through goal tools, the goal-changed notification now also includes that goal's created and updated times.

When listing, reading, or resuming a session, the returned total turn count now includes every turn, including failed turns, interrupted and withdrawn turns, and turns still running.

items.original:
`session/fork` takes the new session's `modelId` and `config` like `session/start` and `session/resume`, reports a refused model in `modelIdRefusal` and unapplied settings in `warnings` (experimental members)
The `session/goalChanged` notification now carries the goal's created and updated times after the agent's goal tools change it
`session/list`, `session/read` and `session/resume` count every turn of a session in `turnCount`, including a turn that failed, one that was interrupted and withdrawn, and one still running

title.zh-TW: 協定開發者：工作區開新工作階段減少掃描外掛
title.en: Protocol Developers: Fewer Plugin Scans When Starting Workspace Sessions

body.zh-TW: 給串接協定的開發者：當專案裡裝了大量擴充套件，每次建立新對話的等待時間現在可以縮短了。系統在整理指示時不再多跑一輪檢查，整體啟動流程少掃描一次已安裝外掛，工作階段能更快進入就緒狀態。
body.en: For developers integrating the protocol: when a project has many extensions installed, the wait time when starting a new conversation is now shorter. The system no longer runs an extra check while resolving instructions, so the overall startup flow scans installed plugins one time fewer and the session becomes ready sooner.

items.original:
A session started over the session protocol in a workspace scans the installed plugins one time fewer, so it is ready sooner when many plugins are installed
A new session started over the session protocol in a workspace no longer scans the installed plugins again just to resolve its developer instructions, so it is ready sooner when many plugins are installed

entries: **Twelve hidden Plush Pals: Bobo, Zippy, Twinkle, Tantan, Minto, Shandou, Nibo, Boqi, Zapi, Lei Tuan, WuQiu and Ban Ban.** They stay out of the normal line-up. When the panel loads there is a 1 in 10 chance one of them starts at the front, and each time the line rotates there is a 1 in 10 chance one of them hops in instead of the next regular pal. Each has ten poses: the usual five, plus waving to a neighbour, a big stretch, running when quota burns fast, a startled jump and a signature move it strikes now and then while waiting.

**Hidden Plush Pals unlock one a week, with a collector's book.** From Tuesday 1 December one hidden pal unlocks each week, in a fixed order; a pal that has not unlocked yet never appears. The first time you open the panel after a pal unlocks, it hops into the line, so a new pal is never left to chance; pals you have already met keep their rare random turns. The first time you meet one, a collectible card flips up and files itself into the book at the left end of the line. The book shows every hidden pal as a numbered card: found ones in colour, standing out of their frames and bobbing gently (hover to tilt), unlocked but not yet met as silhouettes, and the rest with their unlock date. Finding them all turns the book gold. The book scrolls when it is taller than the panel. With Reduce Motion on, the card and the tilt are skipped.

**Share a hidden pal's card (macOS).** When the card flips up it now grows to fill the panel and waits, with Share and Keep underneath. Share offers Post to Threads, Post to X, Copy Image, Save Image and More…. The picture is the card itself, with the usage link on its last line, on a 4:5 sheet. Threads and X open their post page with a line of text and the link filled in, and the picture is already on the clipboard, so ⌘V adds it. Save Image puts it in Downloads; More… opens the macOS share menu (Messages, AirDrop and other apps). Found pals in the book carry a share badge: click one to open its card again with Share and Close. Windows keeps the old card without sharing.

**Share today's usage as a card (macOS, every panel except World Cup).** A round share button sits at the right end of the footer's Today line, in the panel's own colours. It opens a Plush Pals card on every panel: today's date, a pal, today's token total, and a bar splitting today's tokens between services, with each service's tokens and share underneath. Services you did not use today are left out, and so are project names and costs. On the Plush Pals panel the pal comes from the line; elsewhere it is a random regular pal, never a hidden one. Share, the menu and the 4:5 picture work as they do for the hidden pals.
**Plush Pals opens on Windows and keeps your collection across launches on macOS and Windows.** The panel also remembers daily greetings and which weekly quota resets it has welcomed.

**The collector's book catches up on missed unlocks.** Each newly unlocked pal gets a turn, cards open one at a time, and the book's tooltip and card animations work at the panel's current language and scale.
**Today's share card includes Antigravity.** Sharing is available once today's totals are ready, and the card's date matches the day counted.
**Sharing confirms when an image is saved.** The card stays open and shows an error if the save fails. Confirmations for Threads and X stay centered and readable.

**Claude quota picks the newer eligible reading for the signed-in organization.** A newer Desktop reading can beat Claude Code's cached reading even when the two observations are less than a minute apart. usage can also read the matching Desktop HTTP cache without a history file when Claude Code identifies the organization.

**Claude quota from the desktop app works again on macOS.** Claude Desktop now keeps its HTTP cache in Chromium's simple-cache format, one file per response, and has stopped adding samples to `plan-usage-history.json`. usage only read the older block-file cache, so if you used Claude only in the desktop app the Claude card stayed at `--` or kept an old number. usage now also reads the simple-cache format. As before, it reads only local files, read-only, and sends nothing over the network.

After updating Antigravity CLI to 1.5.16, Argon and Orchestrator numbers in the status line stopped matching, and reports dropped those conversations. title.zh-TW: 刪除私有或內部儲存庫前會再確認 fork
title.en: Confirming forks again before deleting private or internal repositories

body.zh-TW:
清理不再維護的 GitHub 儲存庫，不少人習慣在 `gh repo delete` 後面補上 `--yes` 直接跳過確認。現在要刪的如果是私有或內部儲存庫，而且會一併刪掉底下的 fork（從原儲存庫另外複製出去的獨立副本），指令就會先跳出警告。這時你得再確認一次，就算已經加上 `--yes` 也一樣。

如果是沒有人手輸入的非互動式流程或代理程式，執行刪除就必須明確加上同意連帶刪除的參數：

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦就像管理員要關掉大樓的總電源，以前只要拿到授權單就直接斷電，現在發現線路還接著其他人的設備，就會先暫停並要求再確認，連自動排程也得另外寫明同意一併斷電。⟧
body.en:
When cleaning up unmaintained GitHub repositories, many people add `--yes` after `gh repo delete` to skip confirmation. Now, if the repository you are deleting is private or internal and will also delete its forks (independent copies made from the original repository), the command warns you first. You then have to confirm a second time, even if you already passed `--yes`.

For non-interactive workflows or agents without manual input, running the deletion requires explicitly adding the flag that accepts cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦Picture a building manager shutting off the main power: previously, an authorization slip was enough to cut it right away, but now if the lines still feed other people's equipment, the process pauses for a second confirmation—and even automated schedules must separately state they agree to cut power to those as well.⟧
